title: Hydration UI dependency resilience audit
verdict: Fails the directive: external asset metadata can block cold startup despite healthy Hydration RPC. Other confirmed gaps affect isolated features or wallet availability.
scope: Latest upstream master and exact frozen yarn.lock dependency artifacts; locally built production UI, not an identified live deployment. Audit only, application sources unchanged.

findings.title: Asset metadata CDN gates cold startup
findings.scope: entire application with fresh or mismatched asset cache
findings.trigger: Metadata fetch or response body never settles; or HTTP 200 has invalid JSON shape
findings.cause: assetsQuery awaits assetMetadataQuery inside Promise.all; cold registry uses suspense; factory has no deadline and trusts items.map outside catch
findings.verification: 15 factory/query/registry fault assertions; production browser shows malformed metadata root error and hanging metadata leaves 40 skeletons and readonly swap fields at 35s, while Hydration RPC returns thousands of responses.
findings.fix: Build registry from chain data and default singleton metadata immediately; warm and enrich icons independently; validate payloads and bound optional requests.

findings.title: Pending WalletConnect hides healthy wallet accounts
findings.scope: wallet restoration, account selection and signing
findings.trigger: Reown cloud config or usage request hangs while WalletConnect is enabled or restored
findings.cause: AppKit ready waits without timeout; account selector switches every account to provider loader if any provider is pending; eager restore awaits wallets sequentially
findings.verification: Exact AppKit 1.8.19 config and usage resolve fallback on rejection but stay pending on hang; broader UI impact traced in source.
findings.fix: Bound readiness and isolate pending status by provider; display already available accounts; restore independent providers concurrently.

findings.title: Failed 1Click registry stays cached after recovery
findings.scope: cross-chain swap and recovery to Hydration inside selected form
findings.trigger: Token-registry rejection followed by service recovery; hanging registry with external destination selected at startup
findings.cause: XcSwapClient caches rejected or pending token promise; selection loading disables both asset pickers and makes amount fields readonly
findings.verification: Exact xc-swap 0.9.0 still throws initial failure after mocked service recovery; underlying service called once.
findings.fix: Clear cached rejected token promises, add a request deadline, keep Hydration choices interactive while remote choices load.

findings.title: Other-chain outages become verified empty balances or endless loading
findings.scope: affected external chain portfolio and selected XCM transfer; Hydration queries remain independent
findings.trigger: All balance RPC calls reject; or NEAR fetch/subscription first emission hangs
findings.cause: Chain.getBalances removes rejected requests and succeeds with []; raw NEAR fetch has no deadline; combined subscriptions wait every asset
findings.verification: Exact xc-core 2.6.0 NEAR balance query resolves [] on rejected fetch and remains pending with silent fetch.
findings.fix: Return per-asset and per-chain availability; reject total failure; preserve stale balances with status; bound fetch and first subscription emission.

findings.title: Optional vote history blocks chain-only GIGA unlocks
findings.scope: native unlock action for accounts with OpenGov lock
findings.trigger: Subsquare or Neckwork proxy fails or hangs
findings.cause: OpenGov unlock query requires external votes, and native unlock query awaits it before calculating matured GIGA unstaking positions; missing result becomes zero
findings.verification: Source tracing; no wallet transaction submitted.
findings.fix: Calculate independent chain-only GIGA unlocks separately; mark vote-history-dependent amounts unavailable without inferring unlock permission.

findings.title: A hanging optional yield source suppresses all external APY displays
findings.scope: borrow APY columns and net APY; lending chain reads and transactions remain available
findings.trigger: DeFiLlama, Kamino, or Neckwork yield request never completes
findings.cause: No request deadline; aggregate loading returns no APY rows until every source settles; cached fallback executes only after rejection
findings.fix: Bound enrichment requests and display available asset yields independently.

findings.title: Supply modal converts unknown external yield to 0 percent
findings.scope: financial display during a yield-source outage
findings.trigger: External yield request rejects without valid cache
findings.cause: Failure returns null but supply selector converts null APY to string zero
findings.verification: Source tracing; main APY table already preserves unavailable status.
findings.fix: Keep unknown APY nullable throughout transaction summaries and render unavailable.

findings.title: Unavailable trade and lending history appears empty
findings.scope: historical displays; current on-chain orders remain available
findings.trigger: History endpoint fails, including when health endpoint still succeeds
findings.cause: History wrappers omit errors and default missing rows to empty arrays
findings.verification: Source tracing; individual paths may be located by filename if hierarchy changes.
findings.fix: Distinguish unavailable history from a successful empty response and show retry.

findings.title: Async XCM subscription can complete after cleanup
findings.scope: obsolete RPC subscriptions and callbacks during chain or address switching
findings.trigger: Unmount or selection change before async subscription setup resumes
findings.cause: Cleanup checks current subscription variable; there is no canceled guard for late assignment
findings.fix: Use a cancellation or generation guard; unsubscribe immediately on late completion and ignore obsolete callbacks.

findings.title: Indexer sync timeout depends on another render
findings.scope: stale post-transaction account and history displays
findings.trigger: Reachable indexer stops advancing and status data remains unchanged
findings.cause: Date.now deadline checked during render without a timer; successful status probe marks alive regardless of lag
findings.verification: Source tracing; conditional on absence of incidental re-render.
findings.fix: Schedule a real deadline timer and detect indexer lag separately from HTTP reachability.

findings.title: Hanging cross-chain submission keeps Hydration swap button busy after destination change
findings.scope: shared market swap form following a cross-chain submit attempt; app navigation remains available
findings.trigger: 1Click quote or firm quote never completes, then user switches back to a Hydration destination
findings.cause: Cross-chain mutation awaits requests without a deadline and aggregate isSubmitting includes it for every selected destination; changing selection resets form fields without canceling that mutation
findings.verification: Source tracing of UI state coupling; actual ESM 1Click SDK and xc-swap quote helper fault-tested with Axios adapter mocks; no signed transactions.
findings.fix: Bound and cancel quote/build requests; scope busy state to selected operation; invalidate obsolete request generations on selection change.

findings.title: IntentScan outage leaves cross-chain settlement monitoring unavailable
findings.scope: settlement toast for submitted cross-chain order; independent on-chain transactions remain available
findings.cause: Status is read from IntentScan, not directly from 1Click status. Rejection resolves null and keeps submitted/unknown state for later polling; hang remains running without a request deadline. Six-hour record expiry only checked when processing starts.
findings.verification: Source tracing; no submitted transaction or live status request.
findings.fix: Bound status requests, retry with cancellation, display monitoring unavailable separately from settlement outcome, preserve tracking identifiers.

existingProtections: Neckwork health has two-second deadline and does not gate application startup.
Neckwork health failures switch eligible trade displays to legacy Grafana/indexer sources.
Current DCA/intent orders and ordinary swap routing use Hydration RPC.
Money-market contract reads use Hydration EVM transport, not separate Ethereum RPC.
XCM context setup uses bundled configuration and existing Hydration pool context; no proven external startup gate.
Portfolio balance queries run independently by chain.
Hydration destination selection bypasses external token loading.
Main APY displays distinguish missing yield; supply modal is an exception.
Browser rejected 1Click /v0/tokens while Hydration-to-Hydration swap still generated a live quote. Earlier cross-chain pending submission is a separate UI coupling.
